verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents product sizing ranges, such as 1-Click Clusters of 16 to 512 GPUs and Private Cloud at 1,000+ GPUs. It also offers a generic sales contact for reserved capacity and describes on-demand access as first-come. None of this documents account-level quotas, per-instance-type limits, or a defined process to request a limit increase. Quota visibility and increase workflows are a fair axis for a GPU cloud, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.
